result.summary: Found 1 major text-clipping defect where the 'Tokumaru Ramen' title is truncated mid-character, plus minor bottom spacing issue where content sits flush against the tab bar.

issues.description: Restaurant name under first 'Popular right now' card reads as 'Tokumaru Ramer' with the final character clipped mid-glyph despite the row being fully on-screen
issues.suggestion: Fix title container constraints so the full name 'Tokumaru Ramen' displays; use proper truncation with ellipsis if space is limited by the rating on the right instead of clipping mid-character

issues.description: Bottom pizza card image is flush against the bottom tab bar with no visible spacing or info, making the card look cut off
issues.suggestion: Add bottom list padding / safe-area spacing above the tab bar so cards do not appear clipped by the navigation
